name: lizo.ai
description: lizo.ai provides real-time market intelligence for multifamily (MFH) real estate investors and operators. Access 100+ KPIs at the ZIP code, MSA, and individual asset level, including rent trends, benchmarking, comps, and location analysis. Search and compare ZIP codes and MSAs by criteria, look up apartment properties by address, benchmark a property against its market, and get full market reports combining demographic and rent data with nearby apartment supply.

_published_faq.name: How do I add lizo.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add lizo.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.lizo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the lizo.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: lizo.ai provides these MCP tools: asset_snapshot_with_zip_avg, compare_msa, compare_rents_data, compare_zip_code, find_asset, find_msa, find_zip_code, get_asset_data, get_zip_code_data, location_analysis, and zip_code_vs_msa.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to lizo.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to lizo.ai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
lizo.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
lizo.ai is developed by lizo.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
